title: Afghan Sentenced to 20 Years After Mixed Verdict in 2021 Kabul Attack Case
summary_full: A jury had split on whether Mohammad Sharifullah was to blame in a deadly bombing but found him guilty of aiding the terrorist group ISIS-K.
